purpose: Teach: しっぽ/のび/安らぎ/染まっ/くっきり/出先/とろ/割る

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、うちの愛犬、しっぽ、本気で、絶対、振って、嬉しそうだよ、本気で、絶対、可愛い
lines.en: Mom, our dog's tail is wagging so hard. He looks so happy. He's really, really cute.
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered excitement. Quick warm-up into the observation, like he's noticed something and has to tell it immediately. Slight breathless quality on 'really, really cute.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お洗濯物、本気で、絶対、のびのびと、絶対、干してあげましょうね、翔くん、ね
lines.en: Yes. And the laundry is drying so nicely in the breeze, isn't it, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, present attention. Following his thought gently. Warm acknowledgment without breaking his moment. Slow, steady pace — the voice of someone watching the same thing he is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの家、本気で、絶対、安らぎを、絶対、感じるんだ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、好きなんだ
lines.en: Grandpa's house — I really feel so calm there. I really love it, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine observation. Slight pause before 'really' — like he's noticing it as he says it. Tender and serious at once. Not performed; he's working out something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 空、本気で、絶対、夕焼けで、絶対、赤く、染まっているわよね、翔くん、絶対、綺麗
lines.en: The sky's turning so red with the sunset, isn't it, Sho. It's beautiful.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. Slight lilt of wonder in her voice — she's not just agreeing, she's seeing it with him. Unhurried, like they have time. Warmth without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんの写真、本気で、絶対、くっきりと、絶対、写ってるよ、ママ、見て
lines.en: Dad's photo came out so clear. Look, Mom.
lines.style: Quick, eager pull on her attention. He's discovered something and wants to show. Slight upward lift at 'Look' — not demanding, inviting. Genuine excitement, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、出先から、絶対、お電話、絶対、くれたわよ、翔くん、安心
lines.en: Dad called from where he was, you know. You can relax, Sho.
lines.style: Reassuring but not patronizing. She's answering something he worried about without him having to say it. Calm delivery — the voice of someone who understands what matters. Slight gentle exhale at 'relax.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの料理、本気で、絶対、とろっとして、絶対、美味しいんだよ、ママ
lines.en: Grandma's cooking is so creamy and delicious. You should taste it, Mom.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation breaking through. Quick, eager tone — he's recommending something he loves. Slight brightness on 'delicious' — the honest praise of a child who means it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お皿、本気で、絶対、割ることが、絶対、ないように、絶対、注意してね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: Be careful with the dishes, Sho. Don't break them. That's a promise, okay?
lines.style: Clear, kind direction. Firm but not sharp — she's setting a boundary with warmth. Slight lean-in quality, like she's saying it just to him. Expectation in her voice, not doubt.
